title: Young Boy in Suspenders by Bush in Backyard, 1950 Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white deckle-edge snapshot capturing a young boy standing in a grassy yard beside leafy bushes and the horizontal siding of a house. The child is dressed in mid-century attire, wearing dark trousers held up by suspenders over a horizontally striped long-sleeved shirt. Sunlight filters through nearby trees casting shadows against the house. Handwritten in blue ink on the reverse is the date 'May 1950', capturing post-WWII American domestic childhood life.
